question: Which natural compound helps in photosynthesis of plants?
solution:
The correct answer is __Chlorophyll__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chlorophyll:

 
 
• It is a green-coloured pigment that is found in plants and helps in photosynthesis.
 
• The structure of chlorophyll is similar to that of haemoglobin.
 
• Chlorophyll contains a porphyrin ring attached to a magnesium atom.
 
 
• An element that is also an important component of haemoglobin is known to be crucial during the synthesis of chlorophyll.
 
 
 
• For the synthesis of chlorophyll in plants, the elements needed are iron and magnesium.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Photosynthesis: The leaves have a green pigment called chlorophyll.

 
 
• It helps leaves capture the energy of the sunlight.
 
• This energy is used to synthesise food from carbon dioxide and water. 
 
• Since the synthesis of food occurs in the presence of sunlight, it is called photosynthesis.
 
 
 
• In the presence of sunlight Carbon dioxide + water + sunlight → Carbohydrate + oxygen.
 
• Some plants, green algae, and cyanobacteria can perform photosynthesis.
 
• Photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplasts specifically, in the grana and stroma regions.
 
• The process of photosynthesis is commonly written as:

​

 underset{(Carbon dioxide)}{6CO₂} + underset{(Water)}{6H₂ O} xrightarrow[Chlorophyll]{Sunlight} underset{(Carbohydrates)}{C₆H₁₂O₆} + underset{(Oxygen)}{6O₂}

 
• The following events occur in plant cells during photosynthesis. 

 
 
• Absorption of light energy.
 
• Conversion of light energy into Chemical Energy.
 
• Storage of chemical energy in Sugars.
